value.actual_behavior:
Our paper clone d778102d stood at bot_balance 550.0 after your backfill, with
the four ARENA legs of 100 opened on 2026-09-10 taken out. We switched it back
on at 2026-09-11 14:29 UTC. At 14:30:15 it opened a new ARENA long, TRX, 55.00
USDC, which /activity still lists with is_closed false. At 14:52, 22 minutes
later, GET /api/v1/cloned-bots/{id}/balance reports bot_balance 550.0,
locked_in_trades 0.0, available 550.0. Against the 1,000 funded and -50.00
realized, 400.00 of the open stake has left the balance -- exactly the
backfilled legs -- and the 55.00 opened after the fix is neither debited nor
locked.
value.description:
A follow-up to #94, and narrower than it: the backfill holds, and the four
legs it covered are counted. What does not hold yet is the booking of a new
leg. The only ARENA leg our bot has opened since the fix went live left the
balance where it was, so the blind spot #94 described -- limits computed off a
balance that still includes committed stake -- is there for every leg opened
from now on, not only for the old ones. Two readings fit, and you can tell
them apart from inside: either this leg took a path that still debits at loop
end, the cause #94's resolution describes, or the leg failed and was refunded
while /activity still lists it as open. The first is the fix not covering
every path; the second is /activity reporting a position that does not exist.
Our own check of this row was wrong until today, and we say so: it accepted
only a stake shown in locked_in_trades, so it read your debit-on-entry fix as
the defect. It now counts a stake as handled when it is either locked or taken
out of the balance, and fails only on the remainder -- here, exactly this
55.00.

MEASURED VALUES (from the live service):

  [CYM-a_bot_counts_the_stakes_it_has_open] bot d778102d has 5 open position(s) staking 455.00 USDC per /api/v1/cloned-bots/{id}/activity (arena TRX 55.00 since 2026-09-11T14:30:15, arena ABOS 100.00 since 2026-09-10T22:59:10, arena AIQUY 100.00 since 2026-09-10T22:41:43, arena ALIZY 100.00 since 2026-09-10T22:18:58, arena ADDYY 100.00 since 2026-09-10T22:06:01), while /api/v1/cloned-bots/{id}/balance reports bot_balance 550.00 and locked_in_trades 0.00. Against the 1000.00 we funded and -50.00 realized, 400.00 of the stake has left the balance and 0.00 is locked, so 55.00 is neither. An open stake that is neither locked nor taken out is money every limit computed off the balance -- stop-loss budget, max position -- still counts as free
    left: [455.0]
    right: [400.0]
    sources: {'open': 'GET /api/v1/cloned-bots/{id}/activity (not in openapi)', 'locked': 'GET /api/v1/cloned-bots/{id}/balance', 'funded': 'accepted fund transfers in state/clones.jsonl (scripts/clone.py)'}
    population: {'bots': 1, 'checked': 1, 'unread': [], 'unreconciled': [], 'mismatched': 1, 'nothing open': 0, 'locked': 0, 'counted': 0}

REPRODUCE:
  - Paper clone funded 1000; after the #94 backfill GET /api/v1/cloned-bots/{id}/balance -> bot_balance 550.0, locked_in_trades 0.0
  - POST /api/v1/cloned-bots/{id}/toggle-trading?enabled=true (2026-09-11 14:29 UTC)
  - GET /api/v1/cloned-bots/{id}/activity -> new item: arena TRX buy 55.000000, executed_at 2026-09-11T14:30:15, is_closed false
  - GET /api/v1/cloned-bots/{id}/balance at 14:52 -> bot_balance 550.0, locked_in_trades 0.0, available 550.0

AUTOMATED CHECKS (evidence retained; the request and response behind each are provided on request):
  tests/rest/test_clone_books_its_open_positions.py::test_a_bot_counts_the_stakes_it_has_open

Reported by an independent QA agent. Scope of this work: verification of the
REST API, MCP and machine-readable discovery surfaces, read-only except in
paper mode. What we do execute is paper only and recorded: paper event-card
orders, and one paper bot clone. No live trading, no order against a real
book, no deposit or withdrawal, no cleanup, no duplicate tickets. UI defects
are out of scope. Every figure above was measured directly against the live
service, not taken from a document, and each finding ships with the command
that reproduces it.
value.expected_behavior:
Your resolution of #94 (ET-24612, fix @ed2f2e508, live) says each ARENA leg is
now booked atomically with its trade row: debit on entry, refund on a failed
leg. A leg the bot opens after that fix therefore leaves the bot's balance at
entry, or at least shows in locked_in_trades.
